mapper.sql:
event_id AS eventId, title, category, description, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y%m%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(end_at, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y%m%d') AS endDateExclusive,
(TIME(start_at) = '00:00:00' AND TIME(end_at) = '00:00:00') AS allDay, DATE_FORMAT(start_at, '%Y%m%dT%H%i%s') AS startDateTime, DATE_FORMAT(end_at, '%Y%m%dT%H%i%s') AS endDateTime, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(start_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS startUtc, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(end_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS endUtc, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(updated_at, '+09:00', '+00:00'), '%Y%m%dT%H%i%sZ') AS dtstamp
mapper.select: SELECT FROM events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND state = 'normal'
SELECT FROM events WHERE state = 'normal' AND end_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY start_at ASC, event_id ASC
mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, event_id AS eventId, google_event_id AS googleEventId, sync_status AS syncStatus, retry_count AS retryCount, last_error AS lastError, last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_calendar_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sync_status <> 'DELETED'
SELECT FROM user_calendar_events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND google_event_id IS NOT NULL AND sync_status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT FROM user_calendar_events WHERE sync_status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (retry_count + 1) * 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_calendar_events (user_id, event_id, google_event_id, sync_status, retry_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventId}, #{googleEventId}, #{syncStatus}, #{retryCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sync_status = VALUES(sync_status), retry_count = VALUES(retry_count)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_calendar_events SET google_event_id = #{googleEventId}, sync_status = 'SYNCED', retry_count = 0, last_error = NULL, last_synced_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE user_calendar_events SET sync_status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 500) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
UPDATE user_calendar_events SET sync_status = 'DELETED', last_synced_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id = #{eventId}
